{{Quote|Fife. He's Marg Krim's majordomo. I've worked with him before. Usually he thinks he's more than enough to handle a situation.|[[Asajj Ventress]] tells [[Quinlan Vos]] about Fife|<ref name="DarkDisciple" />}}
'''Fife''' was a [[Pyke]] [[Gender|male]] who served as the [[majordomo]] of [[Marg Krim]] and was a member of the [[Pyke Syndicate]]<ref name="DarkDisciple" /> and [[Shadow Collective]] during the [[Clone Wars]]. He fought during the Shadow Collective's [[Battle on Ord Mantell|battle]] on [[Ord Mantell]] against the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" />

==Personality and traits==
Fife was a [[Gender|male]]<ref name="DarkDisciple" /> [[Pyke]]<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> who was 1.91 [[meter]]s (6 [[Foot|feet]], 3 inches) tall,<ref name="Join the Battle" /> with [[Color|magenta]] [[eye]]s<ref name="DarkDisciple" /> and gray skin.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> Unlike many of his fellow syndicate members, Fife was not weak-willed and thus unable to be properly [[mind trick]]ed.<ref name="Deal No Deal Episode Gallery">{{SW|url=deal-no-deal-episode-gallery|text="Deal No Deal" Episode Gallery}} {{C|Slide 11}}</ref>

==Skills and abilities==
As Marg Krim's majordomo, Fife was a highly capable warrior, who was very effective at combat, military tactics, and security.<ref name="Join the Battle" /> He skills as a warrior enabled him to fight with the forces of the Shadow Collective on Ord Mantell<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> and later enabled him to outmaneuver [[Ahsoka Tano]], [[Trace Martez]], and [[Rafa Martez]] as the trio attempted to flee [[Oba Diah]].<ref name="Dangerous Debt">{{TCW|Dangerous Debt}}</ref> Fife was also skilled in organization and bureaucracy.<ref name="Join the Battle" />

==Equipment==
Like many Pykes, Fife was armed with a [[CC-420 pistol]].<ref name="Deal No Deal">{{TCW|Deal No Deal}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Fife first appeared in ''[[Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir 2]]'', the second issue of the [[canon]] [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] miniseries ''[[Star Wars: Darth Maul — Son of Dathomir]]''.<ref name="Son of Dathomir, Part Two" /> He later made his on screen appearance during the ''[[The Clone Wars: Season Seven]]'' episode "[[Deal No Deal]]," where he was voiced by [[Dee Bradley Baker]].<ref name="Deal No Deal" />
